$comment: Deliberately partial (ADR 0007, question 8): only scheduleTime is described and closed. Every other top-level key is left unconstrained, so existing values files and --reuse-values upgrades keep rendering; guards for the rest stay as fail calls in _preflight.tpl/_helpers.tpl. Close another block only in its own change.

scheduleTime.description: dws-schedule-time, the time-trigger scheduler (scheduling Phase 6a, ADR 0013). Core layer, on by default.

enabled.description: Render the scheduler's ServiceAccount, Role, RoleBinding and Deployment.

replicaCount.description: Scheduler replicas. More than one is safe: Dapr delivers each job to one replica and starts are claimed per instance ID.

afterPollInterval.description: DWS_SCHEDULE_TIME_AFTER_POLL_INTERVAL: ISO-8601 duration (at least 1 s, checked by the scheduler at boot) between status polls of an `after` workflow's current instance.

claimTtl.description: DWS_SCHEDULE_TIME_CLAIM_TTL: ISO-8601 duration the per-instance start claims are kept in the state store.

observability.description: OpenTelemetry observability. Deliberately open: only the bundled-collector keys (Phase 6) are described here; the rest is validated by _preflight.tpl.

collector.description: Bundled OpenTelemetry Collector (dev/eval only; point observability.otlp.endpoint at a managed collector in production). Requires observability.enabled=true.

enabled.description: Install the opentelemetry-collector subchart as a DaemonSet whose Service is dws-otel-collector (the default observability.otlp.endpoint). Prints received telemetry to its stdout; has no backend.

opentelemetry-collector.description: Values for the bundled opentelemetry-collector subchart (rendered only when observability.collector.enabled=true). Anything the upstream chart accepts may be set; only the keys the DWS defaults depend on are described.

fullnameOverride.description: Must stay dws-otel-collector so the default observability.otlp.endpoint resolves; change it only together with that endpoint.

config.description: Collector configuration, deep-merged over the upstream defaults. Lists (pipelines) are replaced, not merged.

isoDuration.description: ISO-8601 day-time duration such as PT15S, PT1H30M or P1D.
